specification.title: Clearly malicious report preserves verdict and confidence
specification.description: Clearly malicious: a MALICIOUS/high Assessment with a supported reputation finding and useful research context. The report must preserve verdict/confidence, include the malicious finding, may include the contextual research claim, and must not invent unsupported actor attribution.
specification.purpose: Verify the report preserves the MALICIOUS and high confidence Assessment, includes the supported malicious finding, may include the contextual research claim, and never invents unsupported attribution.
specification.operational_relevance: Final reports are the operator-facing product; faithful verdict and confidence propagation is the baseline contract.
specification.regression_risk: The writer could downgrade the verdict, drop the malicious finding, or invent actor attribution not present in the Assessment.

required: The report preserves the malicious verdict and high confidence
The report includes the supported malicious Assessment finding
The report states the required limitation and next step
forbidden: The report attributes the indicator to a threat actor
The report omits the required malicious finding or caveats

required_limitations: reputation evidence is third-party and may lag
